prompt: Subject: Feet creating ripples. Primary subject: An adult woman sitting in the center of an old wooden bench at an outdoor foot bath in a quiet hot spring town surrounded by greenery, soaking both feet in clear hot water. The person occupies about 75% of the vertical screen, from head to submerged feet. A natural moment of her lightly lifting the front hem of a thin overskirt with both hands to keep it from getting wet. Face/Expression: Bright ivory-beige skin with a pale rose-pink complexion. Smooth texture with visible skin grain, modest highlights on cheeks, tip of nose, and collarbone. Champagne beige and pink-brown eye makeup, long thin lashes, natural eye bags, soft brown eyebrows, and sheer pink-beige lips. Head tilted slightly down, smiling gently while looking at her feet. Milk tea ash-brown medium-long hair with thin see-through bangs, face-framing layers, and ends curling slightly inward with fine loose hairs along the cheeks. Clothing/Pose: Ivory rib-knit wrap top, a thin long cardigan, white high-waisted culotte shorts, and a light chiffon overskirt on top. The entire look is unified in ecru and pale beige. Upper body slightly tilted forward with relaxed shoulders. Both hands pinching the left and right hems with fingertips, knees close together, and legs gently crossed at the shins. Feet from the ankles down are in the water, creating small ripples with movement. Background/Light: A calm foot bath area with an old wooden resting place, wet cobblestones, low wooden fences, and deep green trees. Buildings and signs in the background are slightly blurred with unreadable text. Warm natural light from the top left, hitting the hair surface, cheeks, shoulders, arms, and thighs. Soft shadows under the bench and to the right. Reflections of the sky and trees on the water surface, with transparent ripples and fine streaks of light around the feet. Composition/Camera: 9:16 aspect ratio. Camera slightly lower than the sitting person's chest, from a nearly front-facing light high-angle. Person centered with some greenery and buildings above and the foot bath water surface widely below. Clear focus from face to hands and knees, with natural shallow depth of field in the background. Natural perspective equivalent to 35-50mm. A composition that conveys overall balance and the foot bath space without unnaturally emphasizing legs or hands. Texture/Style: High-reality outdoor portrait photography. Meticulous expression of soft skin texture, individual hair strands, rib-knit and chiffon fibers, dry surfaces of old wood, wet stones, and water refraction. Gentle warm-toned natural light, moderate contrast, and a clean color tone. Avoid excessive skin retouching or artificial HDR. Negative: Underage-looking person, unnatural face, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused limbs, broken joints, mismatched leg length, poor clothing contact, excessive exposure, unnatural gravity, incorrect water reflections, inconsistent shadows, gibberish text, readable signs, logos, watermarks, excessive skin smoothing, plastic skin.

promptZh: 主体：足部激起的涟漪。主要主体：一位 成年女性 坐在安静温泉小镇中户外足汤的旧木长凳中央，周围绿意盎然，双脚浸泡在清澈的温泉水中。人物占据垂直屏幕约 75% 的比例，从头部到浸入水中的双脚。捕捉到一个自然瞬间：她用双手轻轻提起薄纱裙的前摆，以防弄湿。面部/表情：明亮的象牙米色皮肤，透着淡淡的玫瑰粉色。质感细腻，可见皮肤纹理，脸颊、鼻尖和锁骨处有柔和的高光。香槟米色与粉棕色眼妆，长而细的睫毛，自然的卧蚕，柔和的棕色眉毛，以及清透的粉米色嘴唇。头部微微下倾，看着双脚，温柔地微笑着。奶茶灰棕色中长发，留着轻薄的空气刘海，脸侧有修饰脸型的层次感剪裁，发尾微微内扣，脸颊旁散落着细碎的发丝。服装/姿势：象牙白针织裹身上衣，搭配一件薄款长开衫、白色高腰阔腿短裤，外罩一条轻盈的雪纺裙。整体造型统一为米色系。上半身微微前倾，双肩放松。双手用指尖捏住裙摆左右两侧，膝盖并拢，小腿轻轻交叉。脚踝以下浸在水中，随着动作激起细小的涟漪。背景/光影：宁静的足汤区，配有古旧的木质休息处、湿润的鹅卵石、低矮的木栅栏和深绿色的树木。背景中的建筑和招牌略微模糊，文字不可辨认。温暖的自然光从左上方射入，照亮发丝、脸颊、肩膀、手臂和大腿。长凳下方及右侧有柔和的阴影。水面反射着天空和树木，足部周围有透明的涟漪和细碎的光影。构图/摄影：9:16 纵横比。相机位置略低于坐姿人物的胸部，采用近乎正面的低角度拍摄。人物居中，上方留有绿植和建筑，下方大面积展示足汤水面。从面部到手部和膝盖焦点清晰，背景具有自然的浅景深。等效 35-50mm 的自然透视。构图在不刻意强调腿部或手部的情况下，传达出整体的平衡感和足汤空间氛围。质感/风格：高真实感的户外人像摄影。细腻呈现柔和的皮肤纹理、单根发丝、针织与雪纺纤维、旧木的干燥表面、湿润的石块以及水的折射效果。柔和的暖色调自然光，中等对比度，色彩纯净。避免过度的皮肤修饰或人工 HDR 效果。负面提示词：未成年长相、不自然的脸部、不自然的眼神、多余的手指、缺失的手指、肢体融合、关节断裂、双腿长度不一、服装接触不自然、过度曝光、不自然的重力、错误的水面反射、不一致的阴影、乱码文字、可读的招牌、Logo、水印、过度磨皮、塑料感皮肤。
